Title: Platform consolidation: one hub + David's yard
Description: Retire the separate mission-control Next app. One Next app (mission-authoring) becomes the Mission Control hub on localhost:3000; David's yard is the operator/run surface on localhost:3001. Operators log into the hub for admin access.

Title: Retire the mission-control Next app
Description: As a maintainer, I want the duplicated mission-control app removed (and CI, root package.json, README updated) so the platform is one hub + the yard.

Title: Point David's yard satellite at port 3001
Description: As a developer, I want the yard satellite UI served on 3001 (rover backend stays on 8523) so npm run dev brings up hub:3000 + yard:3001.

Title: Operator login and admin access on the hub
Description: As an operator, I want to log into the hub and get admin access so I can manage missions. Port operator-claims + JWT proxy/middleware from mission-control; reuse the hub's AuthContext/firebase-admin; keep set-custom-claims locked down.

Title: Minimal operator API in the hub
Description: As an operator, I want hub APIs to list not-run missions, attach a YouTube URL, and mark a mission run/complete (admin-only). Drop rover-config, simulator, and dispatch routes per David.

Title: Close the loop - Python path
Description: Operator finds a not-run mission, copies its Python, pastes into the yard, runs it, and attaches the resulting video. The priority deliverable; testable this weekend.

Title: Operator page lists not-run missions with code
Description: As an operator, I want a hub page listing not-yet-run missions with their code and a Copy Python button so I can take the code to the yard.

Title: Attach a YouTube video to a mission
Description: As an operator, I want to attach a YouTube URL to a completed mission so the learner sees their run. Admin-only; reuse add-youtube-url logic.

Title: Close the loop - Blockly round-trip
Description: Operator can copy a learner's blocks and load them into the yard's Blockly editor (David wants both Python and Blockly).

Title: Align hub Blockly with the yard's
Description: As a developer, I want the hub's BlocklyEditor to use the yard's block definitions and the JSON serialization API so a learner's workspace is portable to the yard.

Title: Persist Blockly state on submission
Description: As a learner, I want my block workspace saved with my mission (blocklyState field) so an operator can reload my exact blocks.

Title: Copy blocks in the operator page
Description: As an operator, I want a Copy blocks button (when blocklyState exists) so I can paste blocks into the yard.

Title: Yard: import blocks paste box
Description: As an operator at the yard, I want to paste a learner's Blockly state into the yard editor and have the blocks load.

Title: Quick David-asks
Description: Small, unambiguous fixes David named in the standup.

Title: Move email prompt to post-submission
Description: As a learner, I should never be asked for email on landing; only optionally after submitting a mission, framed as notifications. Identity stays on local storage.

Title: Rename brand Rover Cadets to Mission Control
Description: As a user, the app should read 'Mission Control' (layout title, navbar, leaderboard heading).

Title: Simplify generated mission names
Description: As a learner, generated mission names should drop the numeric suffix and dashes (e.g. 'Helios Explorer'); names need not be unique.

Title: Landing as a single-purpose mission viewer
Description: Restyle the feed toward a YouTube card aesthetic; the landing is the mission viewer.

Title: YouTube-style mission feed
Description: As a learner, I want a clean YouTube-like card feed (code + video), with 'Try it yourself' moved out of the card middle, and leaderboard/challenges de-cluttered from the core viewer.

Title: Challenges framing
Description: Keep the challenges page for the marking stakeholder but frame not-yet-operational parts as coming soon.

Title: Frame challenges as coming soon
Description: As a product owner, I don't want to promise teachers challenges we can't operate; mark non-working parts 'coming soon'.

Title: Deploy
Description: Get the hub + yard to a deployable target. Partly blocked on David/Werner's host choice (GCP likely; YouTube for video; Firestore as DB).

Title: Deploy workflow skeleton and runtime docs
Description: As a maintainer, I want a deploy pipeline skeleton and documented build/runtime needs so we can ship as soon as the host is chosen. BLOCKED: host TBD.

Title: Housekeeping
Description: Repo and demo hygiene after the migration.

Title: Archive the old island repo
Description: As a maintainer, I want the old sapient.rocks-mission-control GitHub repo archived (history preserved) once everyone is on the fork.

Title: Architecture diagram for the next demo
Description: As a presenter, I want an architecture diagram (hub to yard to rover) to lead the next demo, as David requested.
